units.source_text: 对某种人来说，这种无意识地流露出来的无可奈何的笑，好像成了引发亲切感的缘由。

en.t: For certain people, this helpless smile that slipped out unconsciously seemed to become a reason for stirring a feeling of intimacy.

units.source_text: 我就是这样，总是不能对自己给人的印象细节负责。

en.t: That is how I am: I can never take responsibility for the details of the impression I give others.
